title: Value of a Reinstated Finch Note — Finch Circle Note Accounting Clause
content:
**Clause.** In the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the reinstated note value is the reinstatement base value times one minus the reinstatement fee share, times the reinstatement lapse share, times the reinstatement return-timing share, plus the reinstatement card uplift, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. The reinstatement base value is the whole Finch Note value applied to the returned unit's order — the Finch Notes applied across every unit of that order, as the order's purchase records show them.

**Values.** The reinstatement fee share is none (0). The reinstatement lapse share and the reinstatement return-timing share are the whole (1). The reinstatement card uplift is 0.00.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An order of two units was paid in part with three Finch Notes of 10.00 each, 30.00 in all.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Reinstatement base value | 30.00 |
| Times one minus 0 | 30.00 |
| Times 1, times 1 | 30.00 |
| Plus 0.00 | 30.00 |
| Rounded half up to the cent | 30.00 |

**Rounding (hypothetical).** A figure of 12.345 becomes 12.35; the rounding is applied once, to the final figure, and never to a part along the way.
